new_result.statement: For independent Y1,Y2,Y3 with even densities nonincreasing on the positive half-line and positive alpha,beta,gamma, Q=alpha Y1^2+beta Y2^2-gamma Y3^2 has global essential density maximum at zero.
new_result.source_valid_application: Three disjoint centered-unit-interval banks with normalized coefficient vectors give an exact physical matrix P diag(1,1,-1) P^T with nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1}; every finite member has ||p_Q||inf=p_Q(0).
new_result.partial_heavy_upgrade: For the aligned limiting partial-heavy family, ||p_Qell||inf=3sqrt(2)[1-(69/320)ell^2+O(ell^3)], so small positive leverage cannot create an off-zero overshoot; sufficiently large finite banks inherit the strict inequality for each fixed small ell.

required_newest_source_applied.result: Theorem C: one-sheet s>=0 exact-rank-three (+,+,-) bound; general two-sheet s<0 side remains open.
required_newest_source_applied.application: The new monotone-square difference theorem proves p(-r)<=p(0) in the separated symmetric-unimodal subclass, closing that source-identified two-sheet/off-center obstruction in this exact target family.

partner_applied.application: Remote m^-2 fragments lie outside unimodality but independently make the diffuse first-order deficit more negative, so they do not supply the missing escape.

correction_status: No retraction required. The proof does not use law-uniform pointwise decay, arbitrary-joint coarea, post-rotation independence, conditional cap moments/suprema, or a universal single physical minor/cross-rank-three cut.
unresolved_implication: Find or exclude a >3sqrt(2) witness with shared-coordinate non-collinear heavy rows and genuinely fragmented/asymmetric cap-one laws, preferably checking the full output maximum rather than only zero.
next_step: Construct a minimal shared-coordinate two- or three-heavy-row frame with exact spectrum {1,1,-1}, optimize fragmented extreme-product laws, and test whether its two-sheet or central peak can exceed 3sqrt(2).
